result.summary: The landlord's reply (event 007) is a progress update, not an approval. Their side met Freya from Riverside Services on site, is waiting for quotes, and will chase on Monday if the quotes haven't arrived. I left the approval pending, placed a hold to chase in 3 days, recorded the new facts and told the tenant what happens next.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 007 gives no APPROVE/DECLINE and no amount. It says quotes from Riverside Services are awaited and the landlord's side will chase on Monday 13 Oct. classify_reply gave approve 0.00, unconditional approval 0.02 and autonomy 'auto'. The next step belongs to the landlord or their contractor and nothing is overdue, so a hold with a follow-up date is the right move. The tenant hadn't had an update, so they got one short message.

alternatives_considered.option: Record approval as approved and assign Riverside Services
alternatives_considered.why_not: There is no approval, no quote and no amount. The landlord's side seems to be arranging the quotes itself.
The case is routine and there is no conflict, safety risk or complaint that needs agency judgement.
They have just told us their next step (chase on Monday). Messaging again would be noise, so the hold covers it.
